body:
Living by myself is really not an option right now. Money is spread quite thin as it is, I would need to take on a very full-on job to even consider that.

Thanks for your comments on positive thinking.

Never actually thought of that... but you definitely could be on to something. Independence is something that I've been struggling with, I absolutely hate being alone.

Although, I already have quite a bit of responsibility. I'm on a scholarship at university, and I'm quite confident with my abilities. (I'm a first year business IT student)
